thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR cinematic wide shot of a single continuous scene in the American countryside, split naturally by a tall chain-link border fence running diagonally through the frame. On the left side of the fence, under a cold grey overcast sky, a long line of shipping containers and stacked plain cardboard washing machine boxes with no text sit motionless at a closed customs gate, a red blank stamp mark with no letters on a clipboard hanging from the gate, muted desaturated colors. On the right side of the fence, in warm golden late-afternoon sunlight, the open loading dock of a large modern factory where a steady stream of brand-new washing machines with no logos rolls out on conveyors straight into waiting delivery trucks, workers in plain uniforms seen small and from a distance. The contrast between the frozen left side and the busy glowing right side is obvious at a glance, so the image raises the question why without any text.
